descriptions.w3d_s4_scroll_handle_destroy: Unregisters and releases a scroll interface handle, optionally freeing its storage.
descriptions.w3d_s4_scroll_set_child: Forwards a child pointer to the held scroll interface with a zero flag.
descriptions.w3d_s4_scroll_bind_to: Passes the held scroll interface to another interface with a zero flag.
descriptions.w3d_s4_scroll_refresh: Invokes the held scroll interface refresh slot.
